title: Sufficient quantum provenance: retained fields and certified recording precision
summary: Quantum executions sharing a provenance record can produce different output distributions. We ask which execution details to retain, and at what precision, to guarantee agreement within a declared Hellinger tolerance. Under a specified channel model, we combine independent stochastic mechanisms and coherent rotation differences to certify recording precision without output simulation or explicit dependence on register dimension.
